Satellite DAPPEr (Delaware Atmospheric Plasma Probe Experiment)
Spacecraft type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status not launched, expected in 2027
Launcher not launched
Organisation University of Delaware
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country US
Oneliner

Map average variations in electron density and temperature versus latitude and time of day in the ionosphere’s F2 layer.

Description

Map average variations in electron density and temperature versus latitude and time of day in the ionosphere’s F2 layer. Another objective is to determine the preferred size for a Langmuir probe to measure ionospheric electrons from a CubeSat. This is the first CubeSat selection from Delaware for CSLI and aims to provide students with hands-on learning experiences on flight systems.
